name: Ethnocacerism
summary: Ethnocacerism is a Peruvian Indigenous ethnonationalism devised by Isaac Humala and carried into action by his sons Ollanta and Antauro, named after the war hero Andres Avelino Caceres. It presents the 'copper race' of Andean Peruvians as the rightful core of the nation, seeks historical revenge on the white and criollo elite, and looks back to the Inca state as a model. In practice it combines military-led insurrection, hostility to Chile, a state-led protectionist economy and socially conservative, machista positions, and critics describe it as having fascist traits.
scope: The radical etnocacerista movement as formulated by Isaac Humala and led by Antauro Humala (Locumba 2000, Andahuaylazo 2005, the Movimiento Nacionalista Peruano of the Humala family, the ASPRET reservists and the Antauro-led parties), as scholars (Alvarado, Zabarburu, Llanos) and reference journalism (Vice, CIDOB, Harper's, COHA) describe it. It excludes the moderated 'integrative nationalism' of Ollanta Humala's Partido Nacionalista Peruano and his 2011-2016 government. The movement's own texts are Antauro Humala's books, which the scholars analyse; Isaac and Antauro Humala's interviews serve as their own account.
